Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Make bare constrained/overloaded fn names self-documenting in REPL

Previously, typing a constrained function name like `foo` at the REPL
produced a type error. Now it displays the function''s constrained type
signature \(e.g. `foo :: \(fn [:Num a a] a\)`\), while using it as a value
in code like `\(let [f foo] ...\)` still correctly errors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -C /Users/alilee/Projects.nosync/rust/cranelisp commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add lazy sequences \(Seq type\) with thunk-based evaluation and unified collection API

Introduces Seq ADT where tails are closures, enabling infinite sequences
\(range-from, iterate, repeat\) and lazy pipelines \(lazy-map, lazy-filter,
lazy-take, lazy-drop, lazy-reduce\). Multi-sig dispatch provides unified
map/filter/take/drop/reduce that work on Vec, List, and Seq.

Also fixes types_compatible for ADTs \(needed for multi-sig dispatch on
parameterized types\) and adds param unification in resolve_overloads so
return type variables propagate correctly through multi-sig calls.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
